clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Felix Whindlebolt seeks shelter after fleeing Gnomeregan. He lost his belongings in the rush, and Frostmane trolls carried them away.

Felix Whindlebolt fled Gnomeregan when radiation flooded the city. In his haste, he lost his personal belongings and tools. Frostmane ice trolls carried his chest, box and bucket of bolts to their camps southwest of Anvilmar. Now stranded without his gear, Felix relies on travelers to retrieve it.
